artworks.title: Eugenia imperatrix (Empress Hummingbird)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of hummingbirds interacting with a plant. The artwork features three vibrant hummingbirds near an exotic flower. The birds have iridescent green and blue plumage. One bird is in flight, while the others are perched on the flower and a leaf. The background shows a soft, pastel depiction of foliage.

artworks.title: Lophornis chalybeus (Festive Coquette)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of hummingbirds interacting with foliage and flowers. It features three vibrant hummingbirds with iridescent green and red plumage, engaged in flight around a flowering plant. The birds are depicted with intricate detail, showcasing their delicate and colorful feathers. They are arranged dynamically, capturing the motion of their wings and the grace of their hovering flight, while they interact with the flowers, which are pink with deep green foliage. The background consists of a subtle, soft blend of colors resembling a sky at sunrise or sunset, providing a serene backdrop for the subjects. The plant branches twist elegantly across the composition, and there is an air of delicate balance between all the elements in the painting. This is in the style of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Glaucis fraseri (Fraser's Barbed-throat)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows two hummingbirds near a group of large orchid flowers. The flowers are mostly white with yellow and pink accents, while the hummingbirds have iridescent green and brown feathers. The background is a soft gradient of pale blue, and there are large green leaves among the flowers. The orchids stand vertically with blooms pointing in various directions, and the hummingbirds are interacting with the flowers.

artworks.title: Eriocnemis vestitus (Glowing Puff-Leg)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows three hummingbirds around a pink flower on a cactus. The color palette includes shades of green, pink, yellow, and brown with hints of blue. The flower is positioned in the upper right corner, surrounded by the hummingbirds, and the cactus extends downwards from the flower.

artworks.title: Helianthea eos (Golden Star-frontlet)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of birds perched on flowery branches. The painting depicts several small birds with vivid iridescent plumage. They are interactively engaged with elongated bell-shaped flowers. The birds are portrayed meticulously, capturing their elegance and agile poses as they feed on the nectar of the flowers. The background is a soft gradient of pale blues and creams.

artworks.title: Diphogena aurora (Gould's Rainbow)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of two hummingbirds near a flowering plant. The artwork depicts two detailed hummingbirds, one in flight with wings fully spread and the other perched, both focused on green and yellow flowers of a leafy plant. The birds have vivid iridescent green throats contrasted with rich, brownish-red bodies. The plant is delicately illustrated, with lush green leaves and slender branches adorned with buds and blooms. The background is a soft gradient of pastel hues, creating an airy and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Clytolaema aurescens (Banded Ruby or Gould's Ruby)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of two hummingbirds amidst foliage and flowers. The hummingbirds are depicted in detail with shades of green, red, and iridescent hues. They are near blue and white flowers, on a moss-covered stone surrounded by green foliage with wide leaves. The background is a softly blended sky. The style is reminiscent of John Gould, known for ornithological illustrations.

artworks.title: Eucephala smaragdocaerulea (Gould's Wood Nymph)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of three hummingbirds interacting with pink bell-shaped flowers on a vine. The painting shows two hummingbirds perched on a curved stem amidst green leaves, while a third hummingbird hovers in mid-air, feeding on the nectar of one of the blossoms. The hummingbirds have green and blue feathers contrasting with the pink flowers and pastel background. The style is reminiscent of John James Audubon, with detailed and realistic representation typical of classical ornithological illustrations.

artworks.title: Chlorostilbona prasina (Puncheran's Emerald)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of two hummingbirds perched on a nest woven into a leafy branch. The painting features detailed portrayals of the birds and their nest. The background is softly shaded, and the leaves and tendrils of the plant frame the scene.

artworks.title: Discura longicauda (Racket-Tail)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of three hummingbirds perched and flying around flowering plants. The painting depicts two flying hummingbirds with vibrant green throats and long tails ending in dark, rounded feathers, alongside a third hummingbird perched calmly on the plant. The plants feature slender, elongated leaves and vivid pink flowers with long petals extending upwards. This is in style of John Gould. The background is softly washed in a light blue. The scene captures the elegance and agility of the hummingbirds amidst their natural habitat.

artworks.title: Spathura rufocaligata (Red-booted Racket-Tail)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows three hummingbirds and a flowering plant with green leaves and a white blossom with a yellow center. The color palette includes vibrant greens and oranges on the birds, softly muted greens on the plant, and a pale background. Two hummingbirds are perched on a branch near the bottom center, while another hummingbird is in flight above them towards the top center, and a tendril extends from the plant toward the right side.

artworks.title: Selashorus scintilla (Scintillant Hummingbird)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows three brightly colored hummingbirds surrounded by large green leaves and delicate pink flowers. The birds have iridescent feathers and are perched among the foliage. The background is a soft, light sky. The painting is detailed and captures the elegance of the scene.

artworks.title: Tharmastura enicura (Slender Shear-Tail)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows three hummingbirds perched on and around an arched set of leaves with blooming flowers. The colors are vibrant and varied, with shades of green, pink, purple, and brown among the birds and foliage, set against a soft, pastel blue and yellow background. One hummingbird is perched on the topmost leaf, another on the curved branch to the right, while the third bird hovers in the air to the left, beneath the others. The flowers are positioned around the center and bottom of the leaves, with pink and yellow tones.

artworks.title: Ramphomicron microrhyncha (Small-billed Thornbill)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows three hummingbirds perched on a branch with a fourth in mid-flight, surrounded by pink flowers. The birds have vibrant plumage in shades of blue, green, and brown. The flowers have delicate petals and green leaves, creating a nature scene reminiscent of John James Audubon's style.

artworks.title: Lophornas reginae (Spangled Coquette)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of colorful birds perched on a branch. The artwork features several small birds with vibrant plumage, predominantly red and green, gathered on a branch with leaves. They are depicted with delicate and intricate details, showcasing their striking head crests and tail feathers. The background has a gentle wash of soft colors.

artworks.title: Docimastes ensiferus (Sword-billed Hummingbird)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of three hummingbirds interacting with a bright, trumpet-shaped flower. The illustration features three hummingbirds and a large, tubular flower with a gradient of red to yellow, surrounded by green leaves. The painting showcases intricate patterns on the birds' feathers and the delicate structure of the flower and leaves.

artworks.title: Lampornis veraguensis (Veraguan Mango)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of two colorful hummingbirds interacting with a plant featuring blooming yellow flowers. The artwork captures one hummingbird in mid-air hovering near the flowers while the other is perched on a leaf below. The vibrant feathers of the hummingbirds showcase a blend of greens, blues, and pinks that catch the eye against the softer backdrop of yellow petals and subtle green leaves. The delicate strokes and attention to detail suggest that the painting aims to highlight the intricate beauty of these small birds and their natural environment.

artworks.title: Spathura underwoodi (White-footed Racket-Tail)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of three vividly colored hummingbirds perched amidst the twisting tendrils and broad green leaves of a vine plant bearing a detailed blossom. The birds exhibit iridescent green feathers with long, slender tail feathers. The vine is elegantly entwined, displaying flowers and buds with meticulous detail against a softly hued background.

artworks.title: Saint Michael
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure in combat with a monstrous character. The winged figure appears to be winning, as they are shown overpowering the creature. The drawing features dynamic motion, with the winged figure holding a sword and pressing down on the monster. The creature has exaggerated features with horns and a grimace. The lines in the drawing are fluid, capturing the intensity of the moment. In the background, there is another figure with raised arms. The drawing focuses on movement and muscle definition, creating a tense and dramatic scene.

artworks.title: Head of a Child [recto]
artworks.medium: silverpoint, heightened with white, on yellow-brown prepared paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (oval): 10.3 x 9.1 cm (4 1/16 x 3 9/16 in.)
support: 11.3 x 10.4 cm (4 7/16 x 4 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up profile of a person's face with the head and part of the neck visible. The individual is looking to the left side, showing their left profile. Facial features include a prominent forehead, defined nose, and full lips. The hair is curly and voluminous, cascading in waves and spirals with detailed styling. The person is not wearing any visible clothing or accessories. The background is a simple texture with subtle tonal variations, framed by a double-lined border within a square paper.

artworks.title: A Monk [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white over (black chalk?) on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (oval): 9.1 x 10.3 cm (3 9/16 x 4 1/16 in.)
support: 10.4 x 11.3 cm (4 1/8 x 4 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an individual with the upper half of their body visible, turned slightly away from the viewer. The person's head is in profile with a partial view of the face, and the hair appears short and styled close to the head. They are clothed in a robe that drapes loosely around their shoulders and arms, with detailed fabric suggesting a flowing garment. In their hand, they hold a cluster of leaves or branches. The background is a soft, muted tone with no distinct details. The artwork is bordered by an oval frame with decorative lines surrounding it.

artworks.title: Christ Healing the Leper
artworks.artist: Attributed to Pieter de Jode I
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene. It depicts figures in robes with one figure extending a hand towards a kneeling individual, while others observe. The central figure with a halo seems to bless or heal the kneeling figure. The background includes abstract detailing of rocky formations and a tree. The drawing is done in a delicate line work style.

artworks.title: The Camel
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a camel with elaborate gear accompanied by two running dogs. The image features a standing camel with ornate equipment including blankets, a spear, and small ornaments. The camel is detailed with fur textures and accurate proportions. Two dogs are depicted at the bottom of the drawing in motion. The scene implies a desert setting with minimal background. The drawing style resembles classic pen-and-ink illustrations.

artworks.title: Christ and the Samaritan Woman
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: Two figures are depicted in the image. On the left is a man in three-quarter view, raising his right hand. He has long, wavy hair and a beard, wearing a long robe. On the right, a woman is seated on the edge of a stone structure with carvings of ram’s heads. She faces the man, holding a large jug. The background includes architectural details, a tower, buildings, rippling water, and a horizon line. A bush with detailed leaves is between the figures.
